faq.heading: Have Questions? Look Here
faq.subheading: Unleash the power of our platform with a multitude of powerful features, empowering you to achieve your goals.

items.q: How does Mikman connect to my MikroTik router?
items.a: Mikman establishes an encrypted WireGuard VPN tunnel between our cloud backend and your MikroTik router using a zero-touch idempotent configuration script.

items.q: Do I need a public static IP address on my router?
items.a: No! Thanks to WireGuard VPN connectivity, Mikman connects securely even if your router is behind NAT, 4G LTE, or dynamic IP connections.

items.q: Can I print custom voucher PDF cards with pricing in SDG?
items.a: Yes. You can generate batch vouchers, customize ticket templates with your brand logo, set prices in SDG, and export ready-to-print PDF cards directly.

items.q: What happens when I add multiple routers?
items.a: You can seamlessly switch between all registered routers from the side drawer and monitor live metrics for each device in real time.
